title: Headless CLI Session DAG Inspection & Export

claims.assertion: Session trees and context compilation DAGs must provide headless CLI commands for CI/terminal introspection.
Implemented harness session tree and harness session export subcommands with JSON and tree formatting.

distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
All session trees, execution traces, and context compilation graphs must expose pure headless CLI subcommands (e.g. `harness session tree`, `harness session export`) alongside MCP endpoints for automated tooling.
